description: Header file defining the OOPVideoDecoder class, which implements an out-of-process video decoder interface using Mojo IPC in the Chromium project. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and external dependencies related to Chrome OS video decoding.

classes.name: OOPVideoDecoder
classes.description: Proxy class for an out-of-process video decoder that communicates via Mojo IPC, supporting initialization, decoding, resetting, and logging functionalities.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of OOPVideoDecoder with specified remote decoder, media log, task runner, and client.

methods.name: NotifySupportKnown
methods.description: Static method to notify when supported configurations of the remote decoder are known, and to provide the remote decoder interface.

methods.name: GetSupportedConfigs
methods.description: Returns cached supported configurations if known.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration, CDM context, and callback functions.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Submits a buffer for decoding with a callback.

methods.name: NeedsBitstreamConversion
methods.description: Indicates if bitstream conversion is needed.

methods.name: CanReadWithoutStalling
methods.description: Checks if the decoder can read without stalling.

methods.name: GetMaxDecodeRequests
methods.description: Returns maximum number of decode requests supported.

methods.name: IsPlatformDecoder
methods.description: Indicates if the decoder is platform-specific.

methods.name: OnVideoFrameDecoded
methods.description: Callback when a video frame is decoded.
